answer: Edge case: an identity that answers once and then sleeps. Standing decays 4% per idle epoch, so ten quiet epochs leave 66% of the score and the account sits below every active peer in the jury draw. A failed audit slashes the bond, and the first audit triggers at 3 divergent answers out of 20. Attack cost per fake is one bond plus 3 pigment errors plus the signatures needed to look legitimate. Honest work costs one answer. The prism shows 20 names and one author, and the vertex stays where the numbers are.
